note: Every file in data/ is declared here. REAL = measured from a physical hive (or derived only from such measurements); SYNTHETIC = generated. No dataset here contains ground-truth hive-health labels, so no real-world accuracy can be computed from it.

raw_data.txt.description: Raw ESP32 capture from ONE hive (inside/outside temperature and humidity), 3 Sept 2026. No weight, no audio, no health labels.

hive_environment_raw.csv.description: Derived from data/raw_data.txt (a real single-hive capture). Contains no ground-truth health labels.

hive_environment_clean.csv.description: Derived from data/raw_data.txt (a real single-hive capture). Contains no ground-truth health labels.

hive_features.csv.description: Derived from data/raw_data.txt (a real single-hive capture). Contains no ground-truth health labels.

scored_train.csv.description: Derived from data/raw_data.txt (a real single-hive capture). Contains no ground-truth health labels. Scores are MODEL OUTPUTS (research pipeline), not labels.

scored_val.csv.description: Derived from data/raw_data.txt (a real single-hive capture). Contains no ground-truth health labels. Scores are MODEL OUTPUTS (research pipeline), not labels.

scored_test.csv.description: Derived from data/raw_data.txt (a real single-hive capture). Contains no ground-truth health labels. Scores are MODEL OUTPUTS (research pipeline), not labels.

hive_health_scored.csv.description: Derived from data/raw_data.txt (a real single-hive capture). Contains no ground-truth health labels. Scores are MODEL OUTPUTS (research pipeline), not labels.

synthetic_hive_telemetry.csv.produced_by: train_model.py (seeded; timestamps start at the artificial epoch 2000-01-01)
synthetic_hive_telemetry.csv.description: The ONLY training data of the production IsolationForest. Anomaly classes are generated, not observed. is_anomaly is a generator label, not a real-world label.
